scripts.seed:content: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin seed-content
scripts.export:content: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin export-content
scripts.content:build: npm run roadmap:meta && npm run seed:content && npm run export:content
scripts.content:similarity: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin build-similarity
scripts.content:gate:scan: cd crates/ml && cargo run -q -p aer-ml --release --bin content-gate -- --all --ai-only
scripts.content:gate:check: cd crates/ml && cargo run -q -p aer-ml --release --bin content-gate -- --json --slug
scripts.content:gate:resolve: cd crates/ml && cargo run -q -p aer-ml --release --bin content-gate -- --ai-only --resolve
scripts.backend:rust: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin knowledge-server
scripts.backend:rust:index: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin knowledge-index
scripts.ml:audio-guide: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin build-audio-guide
scripts.generate:rust: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin gen-article --
scripts.seed:courses: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin seed-topic-courses --
scripts.audio:meta: cd crates/ml && cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin build-audio-meta --
scripts.audio:gate:scan: cd crates/ml && cargo run -q -p aer-ml --release --bin audio-gate -- --dir ../../data/audio --all
scripts.audio:gate:check: cd crates/ml && cargo run -q -p aer-ml --release --bin audio-gate -- --dir ../../data/audio --json --slug
scripts.ml:rag-audio: cd crates/ml && mkdir -p ../../data/audio && for s in rag embeddings embedding-models vector-databases chunking-strategies retrieval-strategies advanced-rag rag-evaluation; do m=../../data/content/$s.json; t=$(node -p "require('$m').title"); w=$(node -p "Math.max(600,Math.round(require('$m').wordCount*0.55))"); echo "→ $s — $w words — $t"; cargo run -p aer-ml --release --bin build-audio-guide -- --input ../../content/$s.md --output ../../data/audio/$s.json --script-cache ../../data/audio/$s.script.md --slug $s --title "$t — Audio Guide" --strip-diagrams --target-words $w || exit 1; done
